title: Under Cabinet Paper Towel Holder (15-Inch) - Solid Brass - Prestige Regal Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your cabinet space with a solid brass under-cabinet paper towel holder that keeps paper towels within easy reach while helping keep countertops clutter-free.

  • Solid brass construction for enduring, traditional style
  • Under-cabinet mounting saves counter space
  • Left- or right-hand opening for flexible placement
  • Concealed screw mounting for a clean, refined look
  • Hardware included for straightforward installation

Specs

  • Collection: Prestige Regal (traditional/classic)
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Cabinet mount
  • Dimensions: 15-Inch L x 7-Inch H x 2.5-Inch W
  • Weight: 3.2 lb
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Paper towel holder and all installation hardware
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Designed to coordinate with the prestige regal collection for a matching prestige regal look alongside classic bath accessories and traditional bathroom hardware.

_previous.title: Prestige Regal Under Cabinet Paper Towel Holder
_previous.description: Attractive design brings together a touch of style and efficiency to your kitchen. This solid brass paper towel holder can be mounted under the cabinet with a left or right hand opening and will accommodate the extra depth of today's super-sized paper towel rolls. This simple counter-saving design fits any décor, is easy to load, keeps counters clutter-free, and is available in 14 contemporary and traditional finishes.
